svg.title: Where the trace is minimised on one pixel
svg.desc: The set of all confusion matrices and segmentation outputs that reproduce one pixel's label distribution q = (0.2, 0.8), drawn in the plane of s, the predicted lesion probability, and b, the estimated false-positive rate. The feasible set is a curved band starting at (0, 0.8). Lines of equal trace are straight lines through that point. The label-swapped solution F at (0.2, 1) has trace 0; the rank-one line b = 0.8 has trace 1; the true solution T at (1, 0.5) has trace 1.3; copying the label, N at (0.8, 0), has trace 2. Minimising the trace over the whole band gives F, over its row-dominant part gives the rank-one line, and over its column-dominant part gives T.
